Chapter 1430 - 9: The Trap

Chapter 1430 - 9: The Trap

As Lin Yuan's true body refined the Seven Divine Treasure Tree, the Taiji Primordial Spirit was continuously exploring the depths of Wanwei's space-time.

The vast and expansive depths of Wanwei's space-time could only be ventured into by Time Lords who have survived billions of calamities, starting at the second tier.

And above that? There are those at the peak of the second tier, who are beginning the last eight thousand calamities as Time Lords.

Swoosh!

A Time Lord examined a certain area cautiously.

His name was Lord Huang Feng, having just survived the tenth billion and one calamity among the ten billion eight thousand calamities, reaching the threshold of legend as a Time Lord.

"Last time surviving the calamity, I nearly failed." Lord Huang Feng surveyed his surroundings: "If I can achieve great gains in Wanwei's space-time this time, I'll have confidence for the next calamity."

'Infinite Calamities' is the path of transcendence with the highest hope among the three paths, with the largest number of Time Lords also choosing this transcendence path.

Compared to 'Infinite Origins', 'Infinite Calamities' provides timely feedback, and each calamity survived enhances strength.

Therefore.

Unless there are special advantages on the other two paths of transcendence, most Time Lords choose 'Infinite Calamities' as their path of transcendence.

"It's said that the last few dozen calamities of the ten billion eight thousand are particularly difficult, rendering real-world strength and methods useless..."

Lord Huang Feng thought silently to himself.

The calamities he had survived so far were considered standard, allowing him to use his own methods and strength.

Thus, receiving benefits within Wanwei's space-time can aid in surviving calamities.

"It's said that the final stage's three billion and three thousand calamities are extraordinary, with no known means of completion."

Lord Huang Feng sighed; such a desperate path of transcendence, yet it's the most hopeful of realization among the three paths of transcendence.

"Hmm?"

"What is that?"

At that moment, while cautiously exploring, Lord Huang Feng's expression suddenly changed, glancing towards a nearby mountain peak.

This mountain peak appeared ordinary, but a vague mysterious aura permeated the surroundings.

"A valuable artifact, this is a valuable artifact deep within Wanwei's space-time."

Lord Huang Feng immediately speculated, elated within.

He cautiously approached the mountain peak.

Being cautious, Lord Huang Feng still conjured an incarnation to enter the mountain peak.

Within Wanwei's space-time, the timeline is hazy and cannot be observed, so only an incarnation can be used to explore the path.

Of course, some Time Lords specifically hire time entities for exploration.

But Lord Huang Feng did not do so.

"So many rare treasures."

Through the perspective of his incarnation, Lord Huang Feng 'saw' numerous treasures within the mountain.

Each rare treasure casually was valued at tens of thousands of pounds of Time Sand.

"These rare treasures are enveloped in a ban, my incarnation's strength is too weak to break the ban."

Lord Huang Feng frowned, and after carefully examining the surroundings again, especially the mountain peak in front, he pondered for a while and decided to enter personally.

If he hesitated any longer and other lords discovered it, the rare treasures within the mountain might not necessarily all belong to him, Lord Huang Feng.

Just as Lord Huang Feng entered the mountain peak.

Shhh—a surge of darkness swept over, enveloping Lord Huang Feng within.

"Is it a trap?"

Lord Huang Feng's heart skipped a beat; upon discovering the peak, he considered whether it was a trap but ultimately couldn't resist his greed.

Darkness spread, making Lord Huang Feng feel suppressed on all fronts.

"I shouldn't destroy this main battle body just yet."

Lord Huang Feng surveyed the surroundings; the more powerful one is, the greater the cost of crafting a main battle body.

After all, the strength of the main battle body is not much weaker than the true body, requiring a vast accumulation of resources and rare treasures to achieve.

So unless there's no chance of survival, no lord would willingly abandon a main battle body.

Lin Yuan's demand from himself was to destroy the Taiji Primordial Spirit when encountering a Legendary Lord.

In other words, unless the enemy is a Legendary Lord, there's no need to abandon hastily.

At this moment, Lord Huang Feng did the same; even knowing he had fallen into an ambush trap, he planned to assess the situation first.

Darkness converged, forming three indistinct figures, observing Lord Huang Feng.

"Lord Huang Feng."

The lead indistinct figure spoke: "Don't struggle; with your strength, you can't break free."

"Hmph."

"This time I, Huang Feng, failed."

Lord Huang Feng snorted coldly, glancing at the surroundings: "It's just you daring to carry such weapons into Wanwei's space-time, aren't you afraid of it all being for naught?"

With Lord Huang Feng's strength, it was revealed that the dark domain suppressing him was a lord-level weapon, and a very powerful one at that.

Otherwise, he wouldn't be so easily suppressed.

Within Wanwei's space-time, crises are everywhere and lords coming in wouldn't carry too many valuable weapons and treasures to prevent excessive loss.

"That's none of your concern."

The lead dark indistinct figure shook his head.

"Speak, what are the terms?"

Lord Huang Feng spoke directly without nonsense.

He could discern that the strength of the three dark indistinct figures surpassed his own, likely approaching the level of a Legendary Lord.

Such powerful entities, especially three, combined with the suppression of the dark domain, Lord Huang Feng knew he had no hope of escape.

"Five hundred thousand pounds of Time Sand."

"Just hand over five hundred thousand pounds of Time Sand, and we'll let you go."

The lead dark indistinct figure stated.

"Five hundred thousand pounds of Time Sand?"
